・Instagram posts should be in Indonesian language and should achieve 2x posts in the month of January 2025.

・Mini-hackathon should have these requirements:
・Expect to have minimum 5 teams participated in the mini-hackathon
・1 team minimum consists of 1 person, max. 3 persons in a team
・Project build in this hackath
